svg.title: Ouro wiring map along the strap
svg.text: Ouro wiring map: what rides on each link and every cable run (side view, tail left, head right)
Pitch 48 mm. Leave a 15 mm slack loop at every joint a cable crosses, lying flat so it bends with the hinge. Tape cables to the solid block only, never across a leaf spring.
BAT 22 AWG red + black twisted, 150 mm, crosses j4 j5; XT30 on the s3 front block at -y, run along the -y edge of s4
H1 15 silicone wires soldered to the cut DevKit pin stubs: SIG1-8 (28 AWG) + 5V, GND (26) + 3V3 SDA SCL LATCH VSENSE (28), 90 mm, j5
H2 5 x 26 AWG: SDA GND SCL 3V3 LATCH (in that order), 230-250 mm, crosses j6 j7 j8
MID 4 x 28 AWG, ESP32 pin stubs -> mid IMU on the module can, 30 mm, no joint
HEAD GND -> right pin P2, 40 mm; white LATCH -> left pin P1
Cables ride on the back of the strap (the inside of the wheel). Bumps = 15 mm slack loops at joints.
M1: 387 mm, 5 joint(s). 147 mm short: 20 cm extension (53 mm spare)
M2: 324 mm, 4 joint(s). 84 mm short: 15 cm extension (66 mm spare)
M3: 261 mm, 3 joint(s). 21 mm short: 15 cm extension (129 mm spare)
M4: 198 mm, 2 joint(s). own lead, 42 mm spare: coil it in the channel
M5: 135 mm, 1 joint(s). own lead, 105 mm spare: coil it in the channel
M6: 72 mm, 0 joint(s). own lead, 168 mm spare: coil it in the channel
M7: 133 mm, 1 joint(s). own lead, 107 mm spare: coil it in the channel
M8: 196 mm, 2 joint(s). own lead, 44 mm spare: coil it in the channel
Servo k sits in the front cradle of s(k-1) and drives joint k. Lengths from cad/check_fit.py (h), MG90S lead taken as 240 mm.
BT1.+ via J0 (XT30, on s3) and F1 (in heat-shrink)
Servo leads are listed beside the drawing above; all runs are also in docs/electronics.json "wires".
